notes: Read SKILL.md in full. The skill covers the Vercel CLI, vercel.json configuration with security headers, environment-variable management per environment, Edge functions and middleware, a GitHub Actions preview workflow, CLI reference, production guardrails, and analytics packages.

Following it can make the agent install the Vercel CLI globally and @vercel analytics packages, deploy to production (vercel --prod), roll back or promote deployments, add/remove environment variables and domains, remove projects (vercel project rm), and pull env secrets into .env.local (SKILL.md:31-115, 204-226). These are the user's own deployment operations listed as reference commands, and the skill adds production guardrails (SKILL.md:228-236), so medium risk is acceptable; production deploys, rollbacks, and removals should be confirmed with the user.

vercel env pull writes real secrets to a local .env.local file, which must stay out of version control. Related-skill links (../../../devops/ci-cd/github-actions/, ../../cloudflare/cloudflare-pages/, ../../../security/network/ssl-tls-management/ at SKILL.md:278-280) are optional pointers.
